title: 街道植栽樹穴海綿設計~Sponge-tree pits for streets
focus: 街樹根域、雨水與人行空間協調~Coordinate root volume, stormwater and pedestrian space
summary: 以「街樹根域、雨水與人行空間協調」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。~Follow coordinate root volume, stormwater and pedestrian space through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.

units.title: 樹穴集水分區~Tree-pit catchment
units.mechanism: 路緣高度與坡向決定哪一段街道供水；樹冠面積不是集水面積。~Curb height and slopes define the supplying street reach; canopy area is not catchment area.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：V=C P A;C=0.85;P=0.02;A=150；計算 0.85*0.02*150 = 2.55 m3。適用限制：單場逕流。~Original hypothetical teaching example: V=C P A;C=0.85;P=0.02;A=150; calculation 0.85*0.02*150 = 2.55 m3. Applicability: Single-storm runoff.
units.verify: 描繪相鄰兩樹穴集水界線。~Map catchment boundaries between adjacent pits.
units.failure: 集水分配不均會一株過濕另一株缺水。~Unequal capture can waterlog one tree and dry another.
units.misconception: 樹冠越大就必定截住更多路面逕流。~A larger canopy necessarily captures more road runoff.
units.practice: 在「樹穴集水分區」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 2.55 m3，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「集水分配不均會一株過濕另一株缺水。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for tree-pit catchment, first reproduce 2.55 m3, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Unequal capture can waterlog one tree and dry another." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 根域有效土量~Effective rooting volume
units.mechanism: 根可利用的連通土量受基礎、管線與壓實限制；名目開挖體積需扣除障礙。~Connected rooting soil is limited by foundations, utilities and compaction; subtract obstructions from excavation volume.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：Vroot=Vgross-Vblocked;12-3；計算 12-3 = 9 m3。適用限制：幾何估計，不是樹種需求值。~Original hypothetical teaching example: Vroot=Vgross-Vblocked;12-3; calculation 12-3 = 9 m3. Applicability: Geometric estimate, not a species-specific requirement.
units.verify: 將地下管線畫入剖面並更新連通土量。~Add utilities to the section and update connected soil volume.
units.failure: 把不連通土穴相加會高估可用根域。~Adding isolated pockets overstates usable root space.
units.misconception: 開挖總體積全部都能被根系利用。~Roots can use the whole excavation volume.
units.practice: 在「根域有效土量」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 9 m3，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把不連通土穴相加會高估可用根域。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for effective rooting volume, first reproduce 9 m3, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Adding isolated pockets overstates usable root space." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 根域孔隙與含氣量~Root-zone pores and aeration
units.mechanism: 土壤水分和空氣共享孔隙；長期滿水會降低氧擴散。~Water and air share pores; sustained saturation limits oxygen diffusion.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：air porosity=n-theta;n=0.45;theta=0.35；計算 0.45-0.35 = 0.1 m3/m3。適用限制：均勻介質的體積分率。~Original hypothetical teaching example: air porosity=n-theta;n=0.45;theta=0.35; calculation 0.45-0.35 = 0.1 m3/m3. Applicability: Volume fractions in a uniform medium.
units.verify: 提高含水率並比較含氣孔隙。~Raise water content and compare air-filled porosity.
units.failure: 將最大蓄水當唯一目標可能使根域缺氧。~Maximizing storage alone can deprive roots of oxygen.
units.misconception: 樹根區越濕永遠越有利。~A wetter root zone is always better.
units.practice: 在「根域孔隙與含氣量」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.1 m3/m3，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「將最大蓄水當唯一目標可能使根域缺氧。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for root-zone pores and aeration, first reproduce 0.1 m3/m3, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Maximizing storage alone can deprive roots of oxygen." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 沉砂與入口保護~Sediment and inlet protection
units.mechanism: 路緣開口可帶入砂、垃圾與冬季鹽分；可維護的前區減少根域埋塞。~Curb openings admit sediment, litter and salts; a maintainable forezone protects the root medium.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：sediment=V C;V=2.55;C=0.1 kg/m3；計算 2.55*0.1 = 0.255 kg/event。適用限制：平均事件濃度假設。~Original hypothetical teaching example: sediment=V C;V=2.55;C=0.1 kg/m3; calculation 2.55*0.1 = 0.255 kg/event. Applicability: Assumed event-mean concentration.
units.verify: 檢查入口與樹幹基部的沉積分布。~Inspect deposition at the inlet and trunk base.
units.failure: 沉積抬高後會把後續逕流導離樹穴。~Accumulated sediment can divert later runoff away.
units.misconception: 入口沉砂不會影響以後的捕水率。~Inlet sediment never affects later capture.
units.practice: 在「沉砂與入口保護」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.255 kg/event，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「沉積抬高後會把後續逕流導離樹穴。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for sediment and inlet protection, first reproduce 0.255 kg/event, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Accumulated sediment can divert later runoff away." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 地表蓄水與根頸~Surface storage and root collar
units.mechanism: 蓄水高程需與根頸、人行路面及溢流配合；幾何容量不等於可任意淹水深度。~Coordinate storage elevation with root collar, pavement and overflow; geometric capacity is not permission for arbitrary flooding.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：V=A h;A=4 m2;h=0.15 m；計算 4*0.15 = 0.6 m3。適用限制：簡化平底樹穴。~Original hypothetical teaching example: V=A h;A=4 m2;h=0.15 m; calculation 4*0.15 = 0.6 m3. Applicability: Simplified flat-bottom pit.
units.verify: 在剖面標示根頸與最高模擬水位。~Mark root collar and maximum simulated water level in section.
units.failure: 蓄水邊緣過高可能使根頸長期淹水。~An excessively high storage rim can submerge the root collar.
units.misconception: 所有樹種都可長期淹到樹幹基部。~Every tree species tolerates permanent trunk-base flooding.
units.practice: 在「地表蓄水與根頸」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.6 m3，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「蓄水邊緣過高可能使根頸長期淹水。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for surface storage and root collar, first reproduce 0.6 m3, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "An excessively high storage rim can submerge the root collar." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 蒸散與灌溉缺口~Evapotranspiration and irrigation deficit
units.mechanism: 雨水補給與蒸散不一定同季節；需以水量帳目估乾期缺口。~Rain supply and evapotranspiration may peak in different seasons; use a water budget for dry-period deficit.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：deficit=demand-captured;0.30-0.18；計算 0.30-0.18 = 0.12 m3/day。適用限制：假想日均需求，非灌溉處方。~Original hypothetical teaching example: deficit=demand-captured;0.30-0.18; calculation 0.30-0.18 = 0.12 m3/day. Applicability: Hypothetical daily need, not an irrigation prescription.
units.verify: 用一週乾天資料檢查儲水是否耗盡。~Use a dry week to check depletion of stored water.
units.failure: 全年雨量充足不代表乾季每一天有足夠水。~Adequate annual rain does not ensure daily dry-season supply.
units.misconception: 年雨量大就永遠不需考慮乾季缺水。~High annual rainfall eliminates dry-season water shortage.
units.practice: 在「蒸散與灌溉缺口」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.12 m3/day，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「全年雨量充足不代表乾季每一天有足夠水。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for evapotranspiration and irrigation deficit, first reproduce 0.12 m3/day, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Adequate annual rain does not ensure daily dry-season supply." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 結構土與壓實取捨~Structural soil and compaction trade-offs
units.mechanism: 人行承載需要穩定骨架，根域需要孔隙與水氣；兩種要求須共同驗證。~Pavement needs a stable skeleton while roots need pore space and water-air exchange; validate both.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：bulk density=M/V;M=1600 kg;V=1 m3；計算 1600/1 = 1600 kg/m3。適用限制：僅表觀密度，無法單獨判定根域合格。~Original hypothetical teaching example: bulk density=M/V;M=1600 kg;V=1 m3; calculation 1600/1 = 1600 kg/m3. Applicability: Bulk density alone does not establish rooting suitability.
units.verify: 同時比較承載試驗與入滲、含氣孔隙。~Compare bearing tests with infiltration and air-filled porosity.
units.failure: 只提高壓實度可能損害根系與入滲。~Increasing compaction alone can impair roots and infiltration.
units.misconception: 路面承載合格就代表根系條件也合格。~Acceptable pavement support proves acceptable root conditions.
units.practice: 在「結構土與壓實取捨」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 1600 kg/m3，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只提高壓實度可能損害根系與入滲。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for structural soil and compaction trade-offs, first reproduce 1600 kg/m3, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Increasing compaction alone can impair roots and infiltration." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 鹽分累積~Salt accumulation
units.mechanism: 蒸散移走水卻不等量移走鹽，根域可能濃縮；需檢查排水與鹽分輸入。~Evapotranspiration removes water without equivalent salt removal, potentially concentrating the root zone.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：Cfinal=M/V;M=0.12 kg;V=0.3 m3；計算 0.12/0.3 = 0.4 kg/m3。適用限制：完全混合且無吸附的示例。~Original hypothetical teaching example: Cfinal=M/V;M=0.12 kg;V=0.3 m3; calculation 0.12/0.3 = 0.4 kg/m3. Applicability: Completely mixed example without sorption.
units.verify: 將蒸散造成的水量減少列入鹽收支。~Include evapotranspiration water loss in the salt balance.
units.failure: 只測雨水低鹽可能漏掉路面與介質鹽源。~Low-salt rain measurements miss road and soil salt sources.
units.misconception: 蒸散會按照相同比例移走水與鹽。~Evapotranspiration removes water and salt in equal proportion.
units.practice: 在「鹽分累積」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.4 kg/m3，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只測雨水低鹽可能漏掉路面與介質鹽源。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for salt accumulation, first reproduce 0.4 kg/m3, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Low-salt rain measurements miss road and soil salt sources." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 樹根與地下管線~Roots and buried utilities
units.mechanism: 以管線位置、可達維修區與根域連通性協調配置，避免把根系直接視為障礙物。~Coordinate utilities, maintenance access and connected rooting space rather than treating roots merely as obstructions.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：clear fraction=unobstructed width/total width;1.5/2；計算 1.5/2 = 0.75 fraction。適用限制：示意幾何，不是法定淨距。~Original hypothetical teaching example: clear fraction=unobstructed width/total width;1.5/2; calculation 1.5/2 = 0.75 fraction. Applicability: Illustrative geometry, not a statutory clearance.
units.verify: 比較移動管線與改變樹穴的兩個剖面方案。~Compare sections with relocated utilities or redesigned pits.
units.failure: 施工後才發現管線會迫使切斷根域連通。~Late utility discovery can sever planned soil continuity.
units.misconception: 地下管線位置對樹穴設計沒有影響。~Buried utilities do not affect tree-pit design.
units.practice: 在「樹根與地下管線」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.75 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「施工後才發現管線會迫使切斷根域連通。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for roots and buried utilities, first reproduce 0.75 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Late utility discovery can sever planned soil continuity." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 生長與水工共同驗收~Joint vegetation and hydraulic review
units.mechanism: 樹勢、入滲與人行安全需分別追蹤，單一綠覆率不能代表整體功能。~Track tree condition, infiltration and pedestrian safety separately; canopy cover alone is insufficient.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：inspection completion=14/16；計算 14/16 = 0.875 fraction。適用限制：巡查清單覆蓋。~Original hypothetical teaching example: inspection completion=14/16; calculation 14/16 = 0.875 fraction. Applicability: Inspection checklist coverage.
units.verify: 將缺水、積水、根浮與入口堵塞分開記錄。~Record drought stress, ponding, root heave and inlet blockage separately.
units.failure: 以樹葉茂密掩蓋路面隆起會漏掉使用風險。~Dense foliage can hide pavement heave concerns.
units.misconception: 只要樹葉茂盛，所有工程功能就都正常。~Abundant leaves prove every engineering function works.
units.practice: 在「生長與水工共同驗收」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.875 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「以樹葉茂密掩蓋路面隆起會漏掉使用風險。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for joint vegetation and hydraulic review, first reproduce 0.875 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Dense foliage can hide pavement heave concerns." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

history: 本課以來源所列的技術指引與研究為閱讀脈絡，並非重建某一設施的工程沿革；算例、數據與場景參數皆為原創教學假設。比較舊方法與感測、控制、資源回收整合的方法時，先固定處理功能及系統邊界，再評估效率與可靠度。~The cited technical guidance and research provide a reading pathway, not the engineering history of a particular facility. Examples, data and scene parameters are original teaching assumptions. When comparing conventional methods with integrated sensing, control and resource recovery, hold the treatment function and system boundary fixed before assessing efficiency and reliability.
